profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Tekronix (Keithley Instruments)
profile.summary: Specialties: c, c++, com, documentation, html, interface design, linux, microsoft c #, microsoft foundation classes, microsoft office,  microsoft windows, python, research, user interface design, visual studio, xml,

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Designed custom software for use in educational and research operations.  Constructed user interface elements to simplify access to complex data sources.  Collaborated with researchers to implement customizable architectures that support fluctuating research models and results.  Authored complete and thorough documentation intended for long-term project viability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked with development teams to design and sustain Rockwell's RSLogix 5000.  Researched solutions for software anomalies.  Established strong communication channels amongst development teams to facilitate implementation.  Focused heavily on human interface design documentation.  Administered and supported automated unit tests using internal testing frameworks.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Demonstrated and instructed Java programming to college undergraduate students.  Designed, administered, and graded informative assignments and exams.  Assisted individuals and groups with writing and understanding the Java programming language.  Provided a collaborative, experiential environment for students based on constructive feedback.
